Crypto-Fascist.name: Crypto-Fascist
Crypto-Fascist.summary: You play as a government agent pushing pills and stack bitcoin in a classic "block pushing puzzle" game.

Dengeki - Big Bang!.name: Clash at Demonhead
Dengeki - Big Bang!.summary: Clash at Demonhead is an open-ended platformer. The player takes control of Billy "Big Bang" Blitz, who is capable of running, jumping, and shooting. He is initially armed with a handgun, though various upgrades can be purchased from a shop. He later gains the ability to perform various powers by collecting Force, including shrinking, teleportation to previously-visited areas, flight, healing, and invincibility. The player chooses levels from a world map that consists of over forty routes. Various objectives must be met to complete the game.

Fox's Peter Pan & the Pirates - The Reve.name: Fox's Peter Pan & The Pirates: The Revenge of Captain Hook
Fox's Peter Pan & the Pirates - The Reve.summary: Play as Peter Pan as you attempt to defeat Captain Hook and his pirates in this game based on an animated TV series.

Mickey's Adventure in Numberland.name: Mickey's Adventure in Numberland
Mickey's Adventure in Numberland.summary: Mickey’s Adventure in Numberland is an educational platform game for the Nintendo Entertainment System starring Mickey Mouse. Mickey travels through Numberland to recover numbers stolen by Pete, moving through themed stages such as Number City, Number Factory, and the Space Center. Gameplay combines side-scrolling platforming with basic number and maths tasks, where players collect numbers and answer simple questions to progress.

Rockman 3 - Dr. Wily no Saigo!.name: Mega Man 3
Rockman 3 - Dr. Wily no Saigo!.summary: It's robot rebellion, and nobody's safe! Least of all, Mega Man! This time the superpowerful cyborg takes on a horde of metal maniacs who've had it with being obedient! And they use every android-annihilator ever invented to make you believe it! Mega Man goes berserk, blasting through a galaxy of mining stations in search of energy crystals. But it takes more than guts to battle the phenomenal robot masters who control these worlds. It's a wrenching job, the worst - and the best - that Mega Man's faced so far!

Rockman 5 - Blues no Wana!.name: Mega Man 5
Rockman 5 - Blues no Wana!.summary: In the fifth chapter of the original Mega Man series, the battle is closer to home as Mega Man fights to save the world from further destruction. Gain the advantage by picking up items and successfully defeating bosses to gain their weapons as your own. Get ready for intense action-platforming in 13 stages before taking up battle against Protoman!
